## v1.9.2 — 2026-03-21

This release introduces significant new features including template profiles with target-specific layouts, a comprehensive free trial system for Pro users, and enhanced team workflows. The update also includes major pricing tier adjustments with Team plans raised to 250 projects and Pro trials now available. Additionally, the release features improved AI positioning with comparison blocks, enhanced billing checkout support, full pino logging implementation, and various tier limit alignments for better consistency.

### ✨ Features

- Add template profiles with target-specific layouts for improved content customization
- Implement free trial page and comprehensive Pro trial system with expiry UX
- Add AI comparison block and enhanced AI positioning features
- Implement Team draft workflow for improved collaboration
- Add billing checkout support with enterprise pricing per seat model
- Implement full pino logging system for better application monitoring
- Add changelog management and widget customization capabilities
- Update navigation with pricing link for improved user experience

### 🔧 Improvements

- Raise Team tier limit to 250 projects from previous limits
- Increase Pro tier limit to 100 projects for enhanced capacity
- Harden release flow processes for improved deployment reliability
- Enhance documentation with template profile details and examples
- Refresh documentation and legal content for latest version

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Harden team workflow continuity and improve tier consistency
- Align tier limits and gate team publishers for proper access control
- Adjust pricing structure with Team plans at per seat per month and Enterprise back to custom contact sales

### 🧹 Chores

- Merge dependabot updates for security and stability improvements
- Bump multiple GitHub Actions to latest versions including checkout, setup-node, and docker actions
- Update development dependencies in minor-and-patch group

### Contributors

@mttaylor, @dependabot[bot]
